name: Duan Stevenson
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I am a PACFA-registered counsellor and ANZACATA-registered therapeutic arts practitioner. My work draws on psychoeducation, creative processes, and relational practice to support people working through substance use, emotional difficulties, behavioural patterns, identity and life change. My approach is grounded in harm minimisation, with a focus on supporting safety, insight and sustainable change without judgement.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Jasmin (Jaz) Forrester
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Jaz holds a deep respect for cultural and individual diversity, recognizing how factors such as gender, sexuality, neurodiversity, mental health, and childhood experiences shape the impact of trauma. ​Jaz is passionate about creating an inclusive and non-judgmental space for people to feel heard and supported; dedicated to helping individuals develop achievable therapeutic goals that align with their core values, fostering a strong sense of identity and self-worth. Jaz works with those facing challenges such as current or historical substance use, mental health issues, childhood trauma, sexual assault, domestic violence recovery, grief and loss, family estrangement, stress, burnout, victims of crime, institutional abuse, and more. Victims of Crime NSW, National Redress Scheme, and Work Safe provider.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Maree Recupero
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I offer counselling and psychotherapy within a compassionate and non-judgemental space where you can feel seen, heard, and accepted. I bring over 25 years of experience supporting children, young people, and their families across diverse settings, including recreation programs, out-of-home care, child protection, and community projects. In 2020, I transitioned into counselling, carrying with me a deep, practice-based understanding of intergenerational and complex trauma.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Elizabeth Sherring
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Counsellor, Psychotherapist & PACFA accredited Clinical Supervisor. Offering brief, medium and longer term counselling or psychotherapy that is trauma informed and inclusive of all people, from all backgrounds, orientations, beliefs and abilities. Whether feeling depressed, anxious, confused, stuck, coping with trauma or grief and loss, my interest lies in supporting people to manage and find renewed mastery in all areas of life and relationship.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Mariano Tabone
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Mariano Tabone is an Australian mental health professional, musician, and researcher with a multifaceted career spanning psychotherapy, trauma-informed care, and creative arts. He possesses extensive experience in trauma therapy, family violence, youth work, and addiction counseling. His practice emphasizes person-centered approaches and Emotionally Focused Individual Therapy (EFIT), with a particular focus on supporting Australian Aboriginal and First Nations families affected by violence and sexual assault. Clinical Counseling Specialised in Trauma, family violence,youth and adicciton. Extense experience working with Australian Aboriginal First Nation families experincing violence and sexual asault healing.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery

name: Cassandra Allen
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I founded Women Assist Counselling in 2016, supporting people who identify as women with their mental health and wellbeing. I use a client-focused and trauma-informed approach. I find it interesting to learn and understand peoples journey’s up until ‘why’ they have booked a session to see me.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery

name: Olivia Romaneix
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I work with teens and adults navigating the impacts of both single-incident and ongoing relational trauma. My approach is warm, collaborative, and trauma-informed, drawing on EMDR, somatic, and creative therapies to support processing and nervous system regulation. My work is informed by experience in the trauma sector with a focus on sexual violence, supporting people impacted by complex trauma.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Christina Borg
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I work with children and adults of all ages, to develop self-regulation techniques, process trauma, connect with the deeper, hidden parts of self, explore lifes challenges from different perspectives, and to create gentle shifts in ways of thinking, feeling and being. We start individual or group arts therapy sessions, with a short guided meditation or self-regulation practices to settle into the space and bring your self into that present moment, as a way of creating space for our somatic, arts therapy session. During sessions, we explore what is present for you through the use of various materials provided, which includes instruments, visual arts, dance and role play props, collaging, writing materials, clay, crafts, recyclable materials and more.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy
